run_doctor_diagnosis: run the hermes doctor diagnostic to check python, packages, config, api keys, and tool availability
run_doctor_auto_fix: run hermes doctor with --fix flag to auto-create missing .env, config.yaml, directories, and symlinks
check_gateway_service_linger: check whether systemd user linger is enabled for the gateway service on linux
check_tool_availability: check which hermes tools are available and which are missing required API keys or dependencies
validate_config_structure: validate hermes config.yaml structure and migrate stale root-level provider keys into model section
